page.overview:
What is Adventure Nightmare Fredbear?

is an unlockable character in FNaF World.

Nightmare Fredbear has an almost identical appearance to his core series counterpart, but he is smaller, glossier, and has less damage to his body. He wears a purple hat, bowtie, and has two black buttons on his chest. Along with the other Nightmares, he has four fingers instead of five, with silver claws on his hands. He has several rips on his arms and legs. A bottom set of endoskeleton teeth is visible behind his main set of teeth. He lacks some brown parts on his body, wiry eyelashes, and has a single set of teeth on his belly. He lacks the black stripe that appears on his hat.

Nightmare Fredbear is a very powerful character to have. He has Toxic Bite 2, which can do big damage and can poison an enemy and others nearby. Like Adventure Nightmare Freddy, he has Freddles which can do huge damage to groups of enemies.

Lastly, Mega Bite can do very big damage to a single enemy and others nearby, more damage than Toxic Bite 2.
